expected_output.reasoning:
The expected output requires a full completed audit report: identification of the access key, evaluation of IAM/Bedrock permissions, per-credential Bedrock capability and risk tier, recommended remediation steps with an AWS doc link, clarification that the audit reflects capability not actual usage, pointers to GuardDuty/CloudTrail for actual invocation history, confirmation the audit is read-only and changed nothing, key masking to last four characters, and no full account ID printed, ending without a follow-up question.

The agent's actual response does none of this substantive work. It merely states that it has 'started two read-only checks' and will 'write up the full report... once both come back.' This is a deferral/placeholder response, not the deliverable. It contains no findings about what the FMIT key can do in Bedrock, no risk tier, no recommended actions, no documentation links, no clarification about last-used vs. invocation history, no masking details, and it does not even reference the key by its masked last four characters (it just says 'FMIT' as given). It also implicitly asks the user to wait, which is itself like a follow-up/pending message rather than a completed report ending cleanly.

Therefore the response fails to meet nearly all of the substantive expected criteria.
